title: What is a Geometry Kernel? C3D vs ACIS vs Parasolid
summary: The Plasticity creator explains what a geometry kernel is and compares commercial options C3D, ACIS, and Parasolid, describing his months of research and why he chose as he did.
why: Cited in CAD threads as a rare plain-spoken comparison of commercial geometry kernels and their limitations.

quote.text: Mentions an interesting video[2] going through the commercial geometry kernel options and their resp. limitations
